name: Tensor Volume Canvas
description: Fixed-view Canvas 2D renderer for API Visualizer-style three-dimensional tensor volumes. It renders a transparent voxel scene with stable occlusion, axes, labels, padding, window, current, and skipped states without owning business selection or container chrome.

visualContract: Canonical NCHW/A1 fixed-view fixture documented by patterns/tensor-volume-canvas/pattern.html

useWhen: rendering NCHW, A1, Load3D, Conv, tiling, or code-recovery tensor volumes with a shared fixed projection
showing padding, sampling windows, current voxels, skipped voxels, or per-voxel labels
embedding the same tensor-volume renderer directly in multiple PTO pages without an iframe

voxel.toneDefault: neutral when no interaction state or explicit semantic emphasis is supplied

requiredApis: window.PtoTensorVolumeCanvas.render(canvas, scene, options) returning { update, resize, destroy }
allowedOverrides: scene.voxels and their tone, state, label, and coordinates
forbiddenOverrides: copying or rewriting the fixed projection, voxel geometry, depth sorting, DPR setup, or ResizeObserver logic in a consuming page
overriding the shared voxel palette or replacing --primary and --warning with page-local blue or orange values
adding rotation, pan, pointer-drag, wheel zoom, or configurable camera controls
moving Load3D, Conv, tiling, playback, selection, or tensor-format business rules into the Pattern
adding product-specific pane, card, toolbar, inspector, or playback chrome inside the renderer
embedding this Pattern through an iframe in consuming pages

colorContract.note: Neutral and padding voxels reproduce the Recommendation Trace API Visualizer Load3D palette. Semantic tones resolve PTO tokens at paint time. Consuming pages must not supply a private palette.

behavior: fixed depth projection uses depthX = 0.52 unit and depthY = 0.38 unit
base voxels default to neutral tone; semantic tones are opt-in and should represent an explicit interaction state or semantic emphasis
voxels render from deep to shallow for stable occlusion
ResizeObserver and resize() refit the scene without changing the fixed camera
backing-store dimensions follow devicePixelRatio without changing CSS size
consumers should call controller.resize() after a theme change so canvas paint resolves the new semantic token values
invalid or out-of-range voxels are skipped with a development warning
empty voxel arrays clear the canvas while preserving axes
current labels take priority when automatic label density hides other labels
the canvas remains transparent and registers no pointer-drag, wheel, pan, zoom, or rotation interactions
originNote: The Pattern is self-contained in this repository; its preview validates canonical fixtures and has no runtime dependency on an external business page.
agentReuseRule: Load pattern.css and pattern.js, then call window.PtoTensorVolumeCanvas.render with a canvas plus a business-neutral scene. Convert Load3D, Conv, tiling, code-recovery, playback, and selection state into voxel tone/state data in the consuming page. Update highlights through controller.update(nextScene), call controller.resize() after theme changes, and destroy the controller when its host unmounts. Do not copy projection or voxel-rendering code, add camera interaction, recolor blue/orange outside PTO semantic tokens, or move product chrome into the Pattern.
